access: Only input objects are public to a forecaster. Enforce the regime-specific development label views. References, rewards, grouping and resource records are evaluator data.
sharing: STOP execution identities appear in both backend frames and count once. Raw actor requests retain the common initial pending query and cached response packets.
inference: Question/support-component sampling; cells and repeats are not independent questions. Primary bank0 inference conditions on fitted calibration. All other banks remain available.
scope: New Flash/Pro experiments stay within one provider family. All new reviews are AI. The controlled one-query contract and original multi-step studies have distinct execution targets.
